continuity.arc_goal: Build Deterministic Simulation Testing (DST) infrastructure for Restate's partition processor targeting TigerBeetle VOPR / FoundationDB levels: Phase 1 (seed-based StateMachine::apply simulation), Phase 1.5 (in-memory SimStorage), Phase 2 (full PartitionProcessor with Bifrost), and fix issue #4566 (awakeable signal loss during leadership transitions) with proper TDD regression tests

progress_update.summary: Built complete DST Phase 1 + 1.5 infrastructure (1000-command seeded simulation test in 114ms, SimStorage with ~63 trait methods in ~920 lines), fixed issue #4566 with TDD regression test (migrated append_signal/append_invocation_response to handle_rpc_proposal_command), verified all tests pass and code is clean. Then conducted a rigorous VOPR review comparing current DST state against TigerBeetle's oracle-based approach, produced 10-gap ranked analysis (oracle/model #1, per-step invariants #2, entropy leaks #3, fault injection #4, crash/restart #5, workload expansion #6, multi-partition #7, liveness #8, determinism self-check #9, run_inner integration #10), and captured findings in durable research artifact with file:line evidence citations. Identified latent non-determinism bug (sim_storage.rs:83 HashMap should be BTreeMap). Code review of #4566 fix was interrupted in Session 2.

decisions: Captured VOPR review as research doc (not memory/skill) — point-in-time artifact with file:line citations, belongs alongside deterministic_simulation_testing_040926.md
Ranked SimModel oracle as single highest-ROI next step — without it, workload expansion only improves panic-catching not correctness-catching
Framed entropy leaks as phase transition — Phase 1.5 tolerates them, Phase 2 cannot; fix must happen between phases not as part of Phase 2
Phase 1.5 tests dedup + state machine layer via SimStorage — does NOT include full run_inner loop (Phase 2 will use Bifrost::init_in_memory + PartitionProcessor)
DST dedup test validates dedup behavior (correct both before and after fix) — does NOT reproduce response-layer bug
Single Action::ForwardAppendedResponse variant rather than per-command variants — all affected sites return Appended response
Custom seed-based command generation over proptest — proptest shrinking doesn't work well for stateful sequences with RocksDB
SimStorage uses in-memory BTreeMap backend for fast Phase 1.5 testing — Phase 2 will use TestEnv with RocksDB
